About Pristine & Sparkling Clean

We're a proud women-owned cleaning business committed to helping you spend less time cleaning and more time enjoying the people, places, and moments that matter most.

Our Story

Pristine & Sparkling Clean was created with a simple idea: your time is valuable, and you shouldn't have to do everything yourself. We are proud to provide cleaning services with care, attention to detail, and a personal touch.

Whether you need regular upkeep, a detailed deep clean, help getting ready for a move, or something completely customized, we're here to make your space feel fresh, comfortable, and sparkling clean.

We're here to clean so you don't have to. ✨🩷
